conclusions: pure rule controller can solve all five targets
reconstructed BC was not a qualified autonomous baseline
RL policy also fails and departs further from teacher actions on the same observations
all 23 training hard failures were judged on policy-controlled steps; state-triggered intervention cannot undo an already terminal step
